title: The Real Work/Life Balance: Setting Boundaries in the Workplace
coreMove: A work boundary is professional when it names the resource, the tradeoff, and the next step clearly enough that other people can plan around it.

exampleSpecs.audience: frontline staff whose help gets treated as always available
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether same-day permits are reviewed carefully or scattered by constant walk-ups
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Veronique notices the coworker interruption pattern and defines a time window for help without starting a fight

exampleSpecs.domain: hospital supply restock under a new assignment
exampleSpecs.audience: employees who receive urgent work while current deadlines are already full
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether patient supply labels are checked or rushed after hours
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before doing any work, Violet allocates scarce time by putting the boss's new deadline against the current priority list and calendar

exampleSpecs.domain: music school scheduling during a grant deadline
exampleSpecs.audience: creative staff asked to absorb urgent administrative work
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether students lose rehearsal time or the grant package misses its deadline
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Irina faces two bad options and uses the priority list and calendar to make the boss choose the tradeoff

exampleSpecs.audience: workers who admire balanced colleagues but never ask how they do it
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether personal time keeps getting eaten by ordinary messages after events
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Weston asks a colleague how she protects work-life balance around after-hours email and borrows the tactic

exampleSpecs.domain: park maintenance tool questions during repair logs
exampleSpecs.audience: teams that fear access rules will make helpful people less helpful
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether repair logs get finished or the shed becomes a constant interruption lane
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the expected loss of help is revealed as cleaner work after coworker questions move into a time window and Slack or email

exampleSpecs.domain: mall kiosk response expectations after closing
exampleSpecs.audience: hourly staff who keep answering ordinary questions from home
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether closing time protects recovery or becomes unpaid message duty
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Diogo separates emergency messages from ordinary after-hours email and protects personal time without disappearing
